result.summary: Removes the initialization of random state from the private broadcast fuzz target. The test does not use randomness, as hash salting was dropped from the underlying feature prior to merge.
result.problem: Setting random state when a fuzz target does not consume randomness causes failures in nightly fuzzing runs.
evidence: "Setting the random state while not using it is causing issues with nightly https://github.com/maflcko/bitcoin-core-nightly/issues/25." (PR description)
result.scope_notes: A one-line deletion in a fuzz test.
result.card: Removes unneeded random state configuration from the private broadcast fuzz test. The target does not consume randomness because salted transaction hashing was dropped before the private broadcast feature merged. Initializing random state without using it causes issues in nightly fuzzing runs. The PR is a one-line test fix resolving CI and nightly fuzzing run failures.

risk.why: A flaw in this change would only affect the harness setup of the private broadcast fuzz target.
